title: German Casserole
description: A hearty German-inspired casserole made with yellowed potatoes, cheddar cheese, and a hint of savory flavors.

ingredients.name: Yellowed potatoes
ingredients.notes: Peel and thinly slice the potatoes

ingredients.name: Cheddar cheese
ingredients.notes: Use a combination of cheddar and mozzarella for extra flavor

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.notes: Melted butter for greasing the dish

instructions: Grease the casserole dish with melted butter.
Thinly slice the yellowed potatoes and layer them in the dish.
Add sliced German sausage on top of the potatoes.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the sausage.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
